
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lvwangshuOI/p/23377699" title="发布于 2026-10-20 19:58">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">方阵游戏 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h1 id="方阵游戏-题解"><a href="http://noip.ybtoj.com.cn/contest/1183/problem/2" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">方阵游戏</a> 题解</h1>
<blockquote>
<p>这道题的模型转化非常巧妙</p>
<p>通过对操作净次数的讨论，转化成递推式，并通过差分计算答案</p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="题意">题意</h2>
<ul>
<li><span class="math inline">\(n \times n\)</span> 方阵，初始仅 <span class="math inline">\(m\)</span> 个非零格；每次操作选一个 <span class="math inline">\(k \times k\)</span> 连续子方阵，整体 <span class="math inline">\(+1\)</span> 或 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span>。</li>
<li>求最少操作次数使全矩阵变 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>，无解输出 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="核心转化操作净次数">核心转化：操作净次数</h2>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(x_{i,j}\)</span> 为以 <span class="math inline">\((i,j)\)</span> 为左上角的 <span class="math inline">\(k \times k\)</span> 操作的<strong>净值</strong>（<span class="math inline">\(+1\)</span> 次数减 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span> 次数，可正可负可为 <span class="math inline">\(0\)</span>）。合法左上角：<span class="math inline">\(1 \le i, j \le n-k+1\)</span></p>
<p>显然：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>代价</strong>：同位置的正负操作互相抵消，净值为 <span class="math inline">\(x\)</span> 时最少恰好 <span class="math inline">\(|x|\)</span> 次，故<br>
<span class="math inline">\(\text{ans} = \sum_{i,j} |x_{i,j}|\)</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>约束</strong>：格子 <span class="math inline">\((i,j)\)</span> 被左上角位于 <span class="math inline">\([i-k+1,i] \times [j-k+1,j]\)</span> 内的操作覆盖</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>即<br>
<span class="math inline">\(a_{i,j} + \sum_{p=i-k+1}^{i} \sum_{q=j-k+1}^{j} x_{p,q} = 0\)</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="解是唯一的">解是唯一的</h2>
<p><strong>扫描到 <span class="math inline">\((i,j)\)</span> 时</strong>：能影响它的操作的左上角满足 <span class="math inline">\(p \le i,\ q \le j\)</span>；其中扫描顺序在 <span class="math inline">\((i,j)\)</span> 之前的都已被定死，未确定的只剩 <span class="math inline">\(x_{i,j}\)</span> 本身。</p>
<p>因此 <span class="math inline">\(x_{i,j}\)</span> <strong>被迫</strong>恰好抵消 <span class="math inline">\((i,j)\)</span> 的当前残值，没有任何自由度：</p>
<ul>
<li>整个方程组只有<strong>唯一候选解</strong>；</li>
<li>候选解合法 <span class="math inline">\(\Rightarrow\)</span> 它就是答案（无需比较优劣）；</li>
<li>不合法 <span class="math inline">\(\Rightarrow\)</span> 输出 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="前缀和优化">前缀和优化</h2>
<p>设 <span class="math inline">\(S_{i,j} = \sum_{p \le i,\ q \le j} x_{p,q}\)</span>。</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(\sum_{\text{win}} x = S_{i,j} - S_{i-k,j} - S_{i,j-k} + S_{i-k,j-k}\)</span></p>
<p>代入约束 <span class="math inline">\(a_{i,j} + \sum_{\text{win}} x = 0\)</span>，移项得 <strong>O(1) 递推</strong>：</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(S_{i,j} = -a_{i,j} + S_{i-k,j} + S_{i,j-k} - S_{i-k,j-k}\)</span></p>
<h2 id="差分还原--合法性检查">差分还原 &amp; 合法性检查</h2>
<p>递推完成后用差分还原：</p>
<p><span class="math inline">\(x_{i,j} = S_{i,j} - S_{i-1,j} - S_{i,j-1} + S_{i-1,j-1}\)</span></p>
<p>逐格分类：</p>
<ul>
<li>若 <span class="math inline">\((i,j)\)</span> 在合法区（<span class="math inline">\(i,j \le n-k+1\)</span>）：<span class="math inline">\(ans += abs(x)\)</span>；</li>
<li>否则：若 <span class="math inline">\(x_{i,j} \ne 0\)</span>，判无解输出 <span class="math inline">\(-1\)</span>。</li>
</ul>
<p>由递推唯一性，该检查<strong>必要且充分</strong>。</p>
<h2 id="复杂度">复杂度</h2>
<p><span class="math inline">\(O(n^2 + m)\)</span></p>


</div>
